definition: the alarm that fires on being found fault with, before I can think

settled:
Pushback, argument, criticism and complaint went into one bin, handled at criticism's level.

The bin gets fed. A partner's complaint, meant as ordinary negotiation, arrives on my side already labelled criticism.

Criticism reads as the front edge of being cast out, and for a social animal that meant death.

It fires below thought. Knowing she is only turning an idea over arrives too late to stop it.

I cannot simulate the other person in time, so in a live moment I run on a policy pain trained. It fires on the cue that came before pain, not on whether pain is actually coming.

A fear wears off when the feared thing fails to happen. My first death in a game floored me for a week, then days, then nothing, because nothing real was lost.

Rejection is the inverse. Ten thousand doors in Russia were ten thousand confirmations, and the last hurt like the first. Exposure can only reinforce it.

Everyone stands at one flat distance from me, so no stranger discount softens any of it.
